comments.author: Donce
comments.body:
I've been grinding maritime near Jolo for three days, and during that period i saw about 15-20 rare fleets of 4 battle galleons with white sails. Today they were especially rare. Me and my friend were looking him for about 1 hour and finally we saw it. After about half an hour fight we managed to plunder this book. My friend had one aide with Ambush skill and the other with Seize Cargo skill and he was doing melee. I was doing only repair and surgery stuff. We had no weapons, only defense items. We tried to keep them alive as long as it was possible, so we kept the number of sailors on melee ship at about 35-40.

We also tried to plunder one more book, and kept fighting for one more hour, or even two hours - the time flied so fast. I returned to Ternate after 99 days sailing :) But we didn't manage to get second book.
